item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 05/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coastal areas of southern China this week. The weather will be generally fine over the region. It will be cool in the morning. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 06/12 (Monday)
Wind: North to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Fine and dry. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 17 - 23 C
R.H. range: 40 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 07/12 (Tuesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Fine and dry. Cool in the morning.
Temp range: 17 - 23 C
R.H. range: 40 - 70 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 08/12 (Wednesday)
